question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Glory**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence before the blank says: "Man is great only because of his labours." The word that follows should express the positive result of work.
 
• "**Glory**" means honour, praise or renown — it fits perfectly after the statement that work makes a man great.
 
• Other options do not fit: "Remedy" (उपचार) means a cure, not the result of labour; "Boast" (घमंड) is an action/attitude, not the honour gained; "Shame" (शर्म) is the opposite of what the passage conveys.
 
• So the most appropriate choice is "**Glory**," which aligns with the passage’s tone about honour coming from work.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Remedy **(उपचार): means cure — not appropriate here.
 
• **Boast **(दोहाई/घमंड): refers to bragging — does not express honour gained by work.
 
• **Shame **(शर्म): is opposite in meaning to the intended positive result.
